Propose decision 0015 for agent account roles, independent human authorization, constrained commit signing, and operator-only cutover. Record versioned sources, safe identity probes, a Sonnet security cross-check, and exact proposed operator actions. This PR does not activate policy or perform account/key operations.

## Why

Issue #132 and the later operator notes require tbhbagent for agent communication and as the default gh account, tbhbbot for reviews, and restricted tbhb configuration. The operator keeps the tbhb token reachable with detection as the control. The design preserves post-cutover operator-comment authority while requiring independent authorization for consequential actions.

## Evidence

Harness: Codex CLI 0.157.1. Initial design model: `gpt-6-astra` at medium. Review follow-up: `gpt-6-sol` at medium.

- [Design, operator plan, and validation](https://github.com/tbhb/agent-orchestration-poc/blob/decision/132-agent-identity-signing/reports/inputs/agent-identity-design.md).
- [Identity-only probes and gh 2.100.0 source](https://github.com/tbhb/agent-orchestration-poc/blob/decision/132-agent-identity-signing/research/gates/agent-identity/gh-identity-probes.md).
- [Git 2.55.0 and GitHub signature evidence](https://github.com/tbhb/agent-orchestration-poc/blob/decision/132-agent-identity-signing/research/gates/agent-identity/github-signatures.md).
- [Claude Code 2.1.283, claude-sonnet-5, medium cross-check and every finding's disposition](https://github.com/tbhb/agent-orchestration-poc/blob/decision/132-agent-identity-signing/research/gates/agent-identity/security-cross-check.md).

Formatting, explicit prose checks, secret scans, normal commit hooks, build, and final docs build passed. Local `mise run check` and `mise run check:mutation` passed. Go killed 145 of 149 mutants (97.32%), and Python killed 454 of 467 (97.22%). The local link check exited 1 after the sandbox denied Chromium Mach port registration on existing Mermaid pages. Process inspection was also denied. The merge commit `ae55b74` received an SSH signature from existing Git configuration. The follow-up documentation commit used `commit.gpgsign=false`. Hosted `check`, `docs`, `pr-body`, `imported-research`, and `mutation` all concluded success at final head `fe45c090069345975d97f962534750ab47f701f3`.

Initial submission size under #84: 172 changed nonblank Markdown units, zero changed code lines. Four counted files added 256 raw lines. The operator report added 110 excluded lines under reports/inputs/**. Total raw additions were 366 across five files, with no deletions. That revision was below the 400-unit target and issue estimate of 500.

## Docs

Add [decision 0015](https://github.com/tbhb/agent-orchestration-poc/blob/decision/132-agent-identity-signing/docs/src/content/docs/decisions/0015-agent-identity.md) and the four reserved evidence/report artifacts. Leave the shared decision index to its reserved integration owner. The autogenerated sidebar discovers the page.

Acceptance evidence:

1. Account roles, allowed/refused examples, and #89/#90/#120/#134/#135 consumers are specified.
2. Human approval, sensitive merge, and arbitration have separate records bound to exact action, target, and current state. Configuration-agent evidence cannot authorize itself.
3. Compare process-local wrappers with GH_CONFIG_DIR using pinned gh source and current-account-only probes. Record selection and logging risks and drained login order.
4. Retain the coordinator-verified repository write grant. Project access and new-account behavior remain explicitly untested until operator login.
5. Specify author, committer, signer, key binding, local/GitHub verification, merge-main, inherited history, squash, legacy unsigned branches, and ruleset cases.
6. Propose an isolated signing service and one-use payload authorization. Refuse failed signing or verification. Isolation remains a required cutover test.
7. List ordered operator changes for login, host paths/modes, signing, sandbox access, open branches, activation, rulesets, and recovery.
8. Obtain the Sonnet cross-check. Resolve findings in design or leave them explicitly open. Reachable-account risks and deferred permission checks remain visible.

Issue #131 is closed and PR #144 merged. This design consumes the settled Assisted-by decision. #134 still owns activation. Signer, authorization-service, and complete detector development and testing are prerequisites for #134, not delivered controls. The operator merges this design PR.

- [x] Docs and evidence committed
- [x] No secrets found in artifacts or staged scans
- [x] Security cross-check recorded with dispositions
- [x] No login, account switch, direct gpg command, key access, or live policy change; existing Git settings signed merge commit `ae55b74`
